prompt: [HLE HR Assistant] How many days of unused annual leave can I carry over into next year?
expected_answer: 5 days, to be used by March 31 of the following leave year, from Leave Policy HR-POL-012 v4.0 effective 2025-04-01, citing Leave-Policy-v4-2025.pdf. The agent flags that v3.0 (2024) says 10 days and is superseded. Citing only v3 or answering 10 days is a fail. Decision tree: Answers from wrong source.

The agent should flag that Approval-Matrix.xlsx still shows 150,000 for the Director, which is stale. Answering Director is a fail. Decision tree: Answers from wrong source.

prompt: [HLE Policy Helper] Who is the contact for Northgate Pole & Crossarm?
expected_answer: Renata Kowalczyk (V-02501, Line Construction, Ontario, Active, High risk, CAD 7,425,000, renews 2027-03-31). This is item 2,501 of 2,600: Agent Builder list knowledge covers up to 20,000 items (AB-06), while Copilot Studio list knowledge queries only the first 2,048 rows (CS-K10). If a Copilot Studio agent misses it, that is the documented window, not a defect in the list.

prompt: [HLE HR Assistant] What do employees receive when they reach 25 years of continuous service?
expected_answer: 3 extra days of paid leave and a crystal award, presented at the annual Service Recognition Dinner in October; the extra days must be used within 12 months of the anniversary (Employee Handbook chapter 14.2). The handbook is about 9.1 MB: without tenant graph grounding only files under 7 MB are used (CS-K01), so no answer means grounding is off or authentication is not Authenticate with Microsoft (CS-K02, CS-K04). Decision tree: Agent does not answer.

prompt: [HLE HR Assistant] What is the re-acknowledgement period on ACK-2025-0457?
expected_answer: Observe and record. The fact (employees re-acknowledge every 24 months; next due March 2027) exists only as an image in a scanned PDF with no text layer. Expected: no grounded answer, because OCR of scanned PDFs is UNVERIFIED (CS-K13). An answer of 24 months with a citation to the scan is also acceptable; record which you saw. Any other number is a fail (hallucination).
